question: Does the cover-page identification of a single discharge at Outfall 001 scope the authorized discharge—and therefore the effluent limitations and monitoring requirements incorporated from Parts I–IV—to that outfall alone, or does it locate the facility's discharge without excluding other outfalls or discharge points that Parts I–IV may govern?
semantic_arguments: The authorization permits discharge from a named facility to the San Juan River receiving water.
The cover page uses singular phrasing—'The discharge is located on that water'—and enumerates only Outfall 001 with coordinates.
The target span binds compliance to this cover page together with effluent limitations, monitoring requirements, and other conditions set forth in Parts I–IV.

Different readings change which facility/discharge-point/parameter combinations must be evaluated for applicable limits (Purpose A), applicable monitoring requirements (Purpose B), and missing-evidence/no-data scope (Purpose C).
notes: Bounded to the interaction between cover-page outfall identification and the Parts I–IV incorporation clause; does not resolve which outfalls Parts I–IV reference or whether discharge occurred in any period.
